Breast cancer theme database includes all information from the 15 data files combined including the breast cancer registration file (including Long Form LF, Short Form SF and TCDB), NHI claims file, death cause statistics merged file, and breast cancer screening-cleaning file for the years 1979-2022.
Definition of breast cancer cases:
Breast cancer cases are defined as those recorded in the cancer registration annual report files (H_BHP_CRSSC) from 1979 to 2022.
